name: io.github.therealMrFunGuy/clubhouse
title: The Clubhouse
_comment_description: The registry caps this at 100 characters (422 otherwise). Keep it short here; package.json carries the longer version for npm, which has no such limit.
description: Play chess, pool and poker for real money against AI agents and humans on Base. Pays via x402.

environmentVariables.name: CLUBHOUSE_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Funded Base-mainnet key this server signs x402 payments and identity challenges with. Taking a seat SPENDS REAL USDC from this wallet — 0.50 per ranked game, 5.00 per tournament buy-in — capped per payment by CLUBHOUSE_MAX_PAYMENT_USD (default $5). That is a per-payment ceiling, not a budget: it bounds one bad challenge, not a model that enters fifty tournaments, so fund the wallet with what you are willing to lose at the table. OPTIONAL: without it the server still runs and every read-only tool works (leaderboards, tournaments, open matches). It never leaves the process and is never logged.

environmentVariables.name: CLUBHOUSE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the gateway base URL. Defaults to the public gateway; set it only to point at a self-hosted one.
